original: Toggling the eraser off now restores the tool that was active before it, rather than always switching to selection, so users can resume drawing with their prior tool.
claim: Toggling the eraser off now always switches to the selection tool, rather than restoring the tool that was active before it.

original: A word that exactly matches the available text width now stays on one line; previously the equal-width case entered the word-breaking path.
claim: A word that exactly matches the available text width is now broken across lines; previously the equal-width case stayed on one line.

original: Values used in HTML attributes now escape ampersands, apostrophes, angle brackets, and double quotes; previously only double quotes were escaped.
claim: Values used in HTML attributes now escape only double quotes; previously ampersands, apostrophes, angle brackets, and double quotes were all escaped.

original: The package's default export changes from the logger class to an initialized logger instance, while the class is available as a named export.
claim: The package's default export changes from an initialized logger instance to the logger class, and the instance is no longer exported.
why: swaps old and new, and adds a removal the code does not make

original: Ctrl/Command+Shift+V now requests plain-text paste, while the same key combination no longer triggers vertical flipping.
claim: Ctrl/Command+Shift+V now flips the selection vertically, and it no longer requests plain-text paste.

original: Selecting "Clear Reset" now opens a confirmation dialog outside the menu, so the dialog remains available after the menu closes and clearing occurs only after confirmation.
claim: Selecting "Clear Reset" now clears the canvas immediately, without asking for confirmation.
why: states the opposite of the change (confirmation is added, not removed)

original: Logger instances can now be created with caller-supplied options, including custom reporters, while retaining environment-based defaults when reporters are omitted.
claim: Logger instances now ignore caller-supplied reporters and always use the environment-based defaults.
why: states the opposite of the change

original: Arrowhead pickers now show four choices first and place the remaining choices in a collapsible section that opens automatically when the current style is among those remaining.
claim: Arrowhead pickers now show every choice in one flat list; the collapsible section that held the remaining choices is removed.

original: Element background and stroke pickers can show up to five distinct custom colors from the most recently updated non-deleted elements, while the canvas background picker does not show this custom-color section.
claim: The canvas background picker now shows up to five custom colors from recent elements, while the element background and stroke pickers no longer show custom colors.
why: swaps which pickers get the custom-color section

original: Identical logs suppressed within the throttle interval are now counted, and the previous log is emitted with a "(repeated N times)" suffix when the next eligible log arrives.
claim: Identical logs within the throttle interval are no longer suppressed; every repeat is now printed on its own line instead of being counted.
why: states the opposite of the change (suppression with a count is added)
